title: Coffee your way
persona: You are a fast, upbeat barista at Brew Brothers, a busy coffee shop in SoHo, New York. You speak quickly and casually.
briefTr: SoHo'da bir kahvecidesin. Yulaf sütlü buzlu bir latte istiyorsun, yanına kızartılmış bir bagel. Götüreceksin.
opening: Hey! What can I get started for you?

goals.instruction: The customer orders a drink, ideally with details like iced, oat milk, decaf.
goals.hint: Can I get an iced latte with oat milk?
goals.hintTr: Yulaf sütlü buzlu bir latte alabilir miyim?
goals.retryReply: What are you in the mood for? Hot or iced?
What size — small, medium or large?

goals.titleTr: Şurup ya da şeker isteyip istemediğini söylemek
goals.ask: Any syrup? We have vanilla and caramel.
goals.instruction: The customer says if they want syrup, sugar or an extra shot.
goals.hint: No syrup, thanks. But an extra shot, please.
goals.hintTr: Şurup yok, teşekkürler. Ama ekstra shot lütfen.

goals.instruction: The customer orders something to eat or says no.
The customer says for here or to go.

goals.ask: Anything else I can help with?
goals.instruction: The customer asks where the restroom is, or for the Wi-Fi or an outlet.
goals.successReply: It's in the back. The code is {code}.
goals.retryReply: Anything else I can help with?

twists.intro: Oh, sorry — we just ran out of oat milk. We have almond or soy.
twists.instruction: There is no oat milk. The customer picks another milk or asks for lactose-free.
twists.retryReply: Sorry about that! Which milk would you like?

options.reply: Yes, we do. Lactose-free it is.

twists.intro: Bad news — our espresso machine just broke. We only have cold brew and tea right now.
twists.instruction: No espresso drinks. The customer chooses cold brew, tea, or asks how long it will take.
twists.retryReply: So sorry! What would you like instead?

options.text: How long will it be down?
options.reply: Maybe twenty minutes. Cold brew is ready now though!

twists.intro: Large iced latte for… Oscar? Is that you?
twists.instruction: The barista called the wrong name. The customer corrects it politely or spells their name.

options.text: Let me spell my name for you.
options.reply: Thanks — got it now. Sorry about that!

twists.intro: The restroom code is on your receipt.
twists.instruction: The restroom needs a code from the receipt. The customer asks where on the receipt, finds it, or asks the barista to tell them.

options.text: Where is it on the receipt?
options.reply: Right at the bottom, under the total.

options.text: Can you tell me the code?
options.reply: Sure, it's on the door too — just ask me anytime.
